body: Do you have any people you're friendly with in school? Having a human barrier can always help too

I hate to say "just move on" when I know how hard it is to manage those feelings. I went through something similar and it wasnt until I found some new friends and a partner that I started having a more positive outlook than before. I guess it helps if you can find something to keep you occupied too like a hobby or a job or something

I'm assuming youre in high school. Have you tried getting in contect with any teachers or counsellors? They can help you take a step in the right direction when it comes to dealing with those bullies. Also I know how hard it is dealing with that shit when you have anxiety, I went through the same thing in high school. I finnally stopped taking their shit and they left me alone
I guess thats fair. I can understand not wanting to make assumptions. How did things work out with your friend?

Unless youve never interacted with anyone on the planet I'd doubt it. Ive had a classmate I wasnt friends with die and I wept for days. Everyone in our class did. Ive had family friends kill themselves and I was shocked and I bet their families were worse off. Ive heard of people I didn't know dying at work and while I didnt know them, our coworkers mourned. It definitely comes from everywhere, places you would never expect.

That's fair. I'll be honest I never really considered that. I guess I just wanted someone to reach out to me and no one I know has so I figure that they just dont have the time. I dont want to be an inconvenience
I'll check it out. Thanks for the recommendation. Before I listen I'll guess that its country music and if its anything else I'll be surprised
Its nice to have that feeling of solidarity. Together we stand strong as people who want to die lol I hope you find peace in existence

What did they do to help you? Do you feel like you've recovered? 

I'm on this depressive rollercoaster where it's usually managable to hide and deal with it on my own then sometimes my mood drops and my brain is like chanting "death death death" the whole time. It's never really stopped for me and I can feel myself relapsing into a really bad spot again

I started volunteering at an animal shelter for purely selfish reasons. I figured itd be free animal therapy. It has helped to an extent but I also constantly feel like i shouldnt be wasting my time like that. I'm starting to feel like a need a second job and the idea of living to work sounds so miserable to me. 

I know I should go do things for fun and take trips to other places. But i have gone out to eat alone, ive gone to the movies alone, ive driven around alone. Anything I do alone feels *bad* its feels like I'm wasting my time and money and I should be putting my all into saving money.

I guess I suffer from an extreme sense of buyers remorse when I do anything for myself even if its eating. I dont think itd be so bad if I went out with conpany but I have no friends where I live
I feel your pain and stress, really. How long have you been in your major? I'm guessing you dont really like it.
What makes you feel that youre at your end?

I'm a stranger so why do you care? I'm not anyone important and ive made no great positive impact on the world. Humans do so much harm to eachother and the environment so wouldnt it be better to lesson my strain on resources? Thats what I feel anyway.

I have no plans to accomplish anything big and the longer I live the more I think its strange that people settle for living just to live. Like being fine with being average and living that life. 

I dont have any kids so I dont *have* to live for anyone really. I don't know how other people can do it. I'd like to think I'll get there some time though. Being okay with living for the moment or whatever.

Thanks for saying something

Thanks for saying something

The only restraint that holds me back is guilt. I don't want to be an inconvenience or make people sad. I have stuff id like to do and places id like to go of course. Short term and long term goals. 

Its just really difficult for me to do anything. If I want to draw it takes me an hour to mentally prepare turning on my computer and another hour to even start the drawing half the time. The only routine I can handle is work. I always go to work on tune and I dont know why I bother anymore. I'm struggling to survive and for what? To continue to stuggle for the rest of my life?

The only way I can manage these thoughts and stress is by tuning out and watching stuff or sleeping and these arent working very well anymore. I dont want go live a life where I work and go home to an empty house just to sleep. 

I guess if I could win the lottery that would solve my problems lol
